# Realized 1031

> Realized 1031 is a comprehensive platform bridging the wealth management gap for investment property owners through tax-optimized 1031 exchanges, Delaware Statutory Trust offerings, and fiduciary advisory tools.

Realized 1031 combines a curated DST marketplace, qualified intermediary services, and wealth management guidance for real estate investors seeking tax-deferral strategies and passive income solutions. The company brings over 120 years of combined real estate expertise to help landlords and high-net-worth clients optimize their investment portfolios.

## Key Topics

- 1031 Exchange
- Delaware Statutory Trust (DST)
- Investment Property Wealth Management
- Capital Gains Tax Deferral
- Qualified Intermediary Services
- Tax-Advantaged Real Estate Investing
- Portfolio Management
- Passive Income Strategies
- Depreciation Recapture
- Retirement Planning
- Real Estate Investment Advisory
- Realized Technologies Platform
- Fiduciary Advisory Tools
- Tax Strategy Optimization
- Real Estate Marketplace
